scripts.ui:fixtures: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- ui capture-fixtures
scripts.ui:check: cargo check --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p ui --features wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.contacts:load:dev: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- apple-sync contacts-load dev
scripts.contacts:load:prod: APP_ENV=production cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- apple-sync contacts-load prod
scripts.contacts:project:dev: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- apple-sync contacts-project dev
scripts.contacts:project:prod: APP_ENV=production cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- apple-sync contacts-project prod
scripts.mailbox:promote: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- apple-sync mail-promote prod
scripts.build: RUST_UI_PROFILE=release bash scripts/site-build.sh && cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p server --bin http
scripts.forge:engine: APP_ENV=production EXECUTION_ENV=PROD cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p forge --bin forge --
scripts.forge:story:reset: APP_ENV=production EXECUTION_ENV=PROD cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge reset
scripts.forge:clean: APP_ENV=production EXECUTION_ENV=PROD cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge clean --force
scripts.forge:batch:status: APP_ENV=production cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge batch-status
scripts.forge:board: APP_ENV=production cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge board
scripts.forge:story:show: APP_ENV=production cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge story-show
scripts.forge:doctor: APP_ENV=production cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge doctor
scripts.forge:packet-lint: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge harness-lint
scripts.forge:guard-lint: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge guard-lint
scripts.forge:manifest: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge manifest
scripts.forge:manifest:check: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge manifest --check-all
scripts.forge:sync-agents: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge sync-agents
scripts.forge:harness: pnpm forge:sync-agents --check && pnpm forge:manifest --check-all && pnpm forge:packet-lint
scripts.smoke:prod: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- smoke prod
scripts.test:deploy-gate: pnpm db:parity && pnpm test:app && pnpm test:forge:engine
scripts.test:section: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge test-section
scripts.test:changed: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge test-section --changed
scripts.test:sections: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge test-section --list
scripts.broken:ts:sweep: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge ts-sweep
scripts.broken:ts:commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge dead-commands
scripts.protected-files: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge protected-files
scripts.forge:roi: APP_ENV=production cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- forge roi
scripts.agent:work: APP_ENV=production EXECUTION_ENV=PROD cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p forge --bin forge-worker --
scripts.agent:scheduler:install: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- launchd agent-worker install
scripts.agent:scheduler:status: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- launchd agent-worker status
scripts.agent:scheduler:run: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- launchd agent-worker run
scripts.agent:scheduler:stop: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- launchd agent-worker stop
scripts.agent:scheduler:uninstall: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- launchd agent-worker uninstall
scripts.db:parity: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- db-tool parity
scripts.db:migrate: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- db-tool apply
scripts.db:migrations: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p cli -- db-tool status
